source_title: Sunset World Group Congratulates Sunset Royal Beach Resort on its 32nd Anniversary
source_excerpt:
CANCÃN, Mexico , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Sunset World Group proudly celebrates the 32nd anniversary of Sunset Royal Beach Resort. As the company's first hotel development and one of CancÃºn's most iconic resorts, it has played a fundamental role in the history and growth of this Mexican family-owned business since opening on October 29, 1994.
Boasting a prime location facing the turquoise waters of the Caribbean Sea, Sunset Royal has established itself as a favorite among members and guests alike. This success is due to its warm hospitality, family-friendly atmosphere, and constant evolution in delivering memorable vacation experiences.
Over the past 32 years, the resort has upheld its commitment to service excellence. It complements its attractive All-Inclusive plan with diverse dining options, recreational activities, entertainment for all ages, and spaces dedicated to relaxation and wellness. By continuously adapting to the expectations of new generations of travelers, the resort has consistently earned accolades such as RCI's Gold Crown and TripAdvisor's Travelers' Choice awards.
Beyond marking Sunset World's Group entry into the hospitality industry, Sunset Royal embodies the hard work, dedication, and passion of generations of staff members who have helped build this success story. It also reflects the trust and loyalty of the thousands of members and guests who choose it year after year as their vacation home in the Mexican Caribbean.
On this significant anniversary, Sunset World Group extends warm congratulations to the entire Sunset Royal Beach Resort family. The group reaffirms its commitment to delivering extraordinary experiences while upholding the essence of Mexican hospitality that has defined the company for over three decades.
Resting on the shores of a beautiful white sand beach in Mexico's Caribbean with charming views of the Cancun skyline, Sunset Royal offers fine entertainment and activities for the whole family all throughout the day and well into the evening. Sunset Royal's excellent location provides convenient access to the best in travel entertainment, nightclubs, restaurants, as well as shopping. The all-inclusive plan gives you the opportunity to enjoy exquisite international cuisine, premium beverages and activities at both Sunset Royal and Sunset Marina resorts. Ground transportation between our CancÃºn resorts and hotels, as well as water transportation to and from Sunset Marina, is also provided.
About Sunset World Resorts & Vacation Experiences
Sunset World Group is a Mexican family business founded by some of the pioneers of Cancun who helped turn it into the most sought-after tourist destination worldwide. Sunset World Group has more than 30 years of experience in the hospitality industry and a sincere passion for environmental conservation, which is why it implemented an Energy Efficiency Program by substituting supply technologies in its six hotels in Cancun and The Riviera Maya. In addition, all Sunset World hotels are supplied with clean and renewable energy produced at Mexican wind farms and geothermal plants, which has considerably reduced the company's carbon footprint. The activity and gastronomy programs in all six hotels are updated and expanded constantly for the enjoyment of all family members, since Sunset World Group always focuses on providing the best vacation experiences for its members and guests.
